accelgor.label: Accelgor
accelgor.note: Grants the holder 10% cooldown reduction for 70s.

Bulk Up.note: Machop: Attack +15% while Bulk Up is up. Attack speed stays the sheet value.

Submission+.note: On hit at level 11+, critical-hit rate +10% for 3s.

Cross Chop.note: On hit, critical-hit rate +5% for 3s. The move's own +5% crit chance is separate.

Unite Buff.note: Barrage Blow: Attack +25%, move speed +10%, Defense +300, Sp. Def +300 for 8s.

Basic Attack.note: Each hit grants +3% attack speed for 2.5s, up to 4 stacks.

Unite Buff.note: Azure Spy Vision doubles critical-hit rate while active.

Dragon Dance.note: One stack. Attack caps at +30%. Move speed +30% lasts 1s.
